## About The Project

[![Product Screenshot](images/screenshot.png)](https://example.com)

ReadMeGen interviews you about a project and generates a complete README.md so you never hand-write one again.

Here's why this project is worth your time:
* Saves you from writing a README by hand
* Keeps a consistent structure across your projects

### Built With

* Node.js
* Electron
* inquirer

<p align="right">(<a href="#readme-top">back to top</a>)</p>

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

You need Node.js 22+ and npm installed.

### Installation

1. Clone the repo
   ```sh
   git clone https://github.com/deawar/readMeGen.git
   ```
2. Install dependencies
   ```sh
   npm install
   ```

<p align="right">(<a href="#readme-top">back to top</a>)</p>

## Usage

```sh
npm run cli
```
